characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Apt to Panic, Collateral Damage, Fear the Law, Pack (6)

rules.name: Apt to Panic
rules.description:
At the end of each turn roll a Combat dice for each Citizen model on the table.
[Hit]= They make one normal Move action directly away from the closest non-Citizen model.
[Armour]= They take no action and remain stationary.
[Special]= They make one Move action towards the closest model regardless of type. Can move around Blocking terrain but no regards for dangers.

rules.name: Collateral Damage
rules.description:
Roll a combat dice for each Citizen in the line of fire.
[Hit]= Resolve the ranged attack against the citizen model(s) as well as the intended target.
Judges will only resolve the attack on Citizens on a [Special] Combat dice roll.

rules.name: Fear the Law
rules.description: Any Citizen within 8" of a Judge using the Respect the Law skill can be moved by the Justice Department player up to one normal Move. The Justice Department player also gets to decide whether the Citizens that are within 8" of a Judge have to roll for Apt to Panic at the end of the turn or not.

rules.name: Pack
rules.description:
Citizens normaly do not generate Action chips of thei own. However if someone else uses an Action chip to activate the Citizens they follow the Pack rules.
Up to six can be activated at once.
